findings.F1: Where a day closes in its own range points the next week's move. On the non-overlapping 7-day grid, the days closing in the top fifth of their range (mean close position 0.91) are followed by +4.22 % beyond the coin's drift (t 2.43 with one day's cases taken together; 277 cases on 95 days), and the Spearman correlation of close position with the 7-day unusual move is +0.081 (p 0.0025, 1391 cases). The correlation is positive on all 10 coins (0.02 to 0.29), in 3 of 4 years (2019 0.18, 2020 0.05, 2021 0.09, 2018 -0.01) and in 7 of 12 windows (w18 0.47, w8 0.41).
findings.F2: This close-position effect is not cleanly graded and shows only over a week. The middle fifth (close position 0.56) is followed by -2.66 % (t -1.92), below the bottom fifth's -1.53 % (t -0.86). Over 1 day the top fifth reverses slightly (-0.37 %, t -1.75), and over 3 days every fifth is flat (|t| < 1). By the multiple-angle standard it is a candidate, not a strong result.
findings.F3: The close-position effect is strongest in choppy calm bars. There the rank correlation is +0.41 and the top-minus-bottom gap is +12.1 % over 7 days (60 cases). In rising agitated bars it is +0.25 and +13.3 % (114 cases). In choppy agitated (49 cases), falling agitated (119) and falling calm (166) it is near 0 (+0.03, +0.06, +0.07).
findings.F4: The tested idea barely acts in the folds shown, and its trades lose with no gradient. Only 78 of 1473 grid bars fall in its choppy agitated profile. Its 186 trades are all shorts, losing -4.0 % net on mean. By entry-forecast quartile, from deepest to shallowest, they return -5.9 %, +1.3 %, -8.3 % and -2.6 %, so deeper month falls do not pay more.
findings.F5: In chop bars, the past month's return relates to the next week only weakly and not monotonically. The second-lowest month quintile is followed by -2.2 % (t -2.24) and the fourth by +3.0 % (t 2.39). Both extreme quintiles are flat: -0.5 % (t -0.50) and +1.1 % (t 0.94). The overall rank correlation is +0.05 (p 0.11, 945 cases), so the brief's graded continuation is not visible in these folds.
findings.F6: Neither the weekday nor the coin's recent swing explains the next moves. Against each coin's drift, no weekday's daily return stands out: |t| ≤ 1.43 with one day's cases taken together, about 206 days each. The 20-day volatility quintiles give 7-day unusual moves between -0.8 % and +0.8 % (|t| < 0.9). The day's range scaled by its own 30-day mean is flat across quintiles (|t| < 0.7).

ideas.idea: In a choppy, calm market, the nearer a coin's daily close sits to the day's high, as a share of the day's range, the more the coin rises over the next 7 days. The nearer it sits to the day's low, the more it falls.
ideas.consequence: In a trendless, quiet market, a trader leans with the day's closing location, in proportion to how near the high or the low the day closed, and holds about a week.
ideas.name: choppy calm close location continuation
